model: Four LABELLED lattice sites on a periodic ring. Each occupancy configuration has exactly two Aand two B. Its energy is10meV times the number of unlike nearest-neighbor edges,each listed edge counted once. No other interaction,kinetic or vibrational entropy is included.
ensemble: Canonical equilibrium over every distinct labelled occupancy assignment at the fixed composition. Rotating a configuration does not create a new energy class,but the different labelled assignments remain different microstates contributing their degeneracy. Do not sum all2^4compositions or give each rotation orbit equal statistical weight.
reporting: Return total allowed microstate count,distinct energies sorted ascending and corresponding degeneracies,probability of an alternating A/B configuration(total over all such microstates),mean energy,S_config/k_B,and C_config/k_B at the stated kBT. Entropy is of the complete labelled fixed-composition canonical distribution; heat capacity is the fixed-parameter canonical derivative or equivalent energy variance.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled finite physical model; not a measured material or an upstream database calculation.
